first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The dark gray-black handgun continuously visible in the lower-right foreground, with a short body and a square slide; the lower grip area is only partially visible.

entities.name: group of metal barrels
entities.identification: The two cylindrical metal barrels positioned side by side near the wall in the middle of the opening view, with horizontal bands around their bodies.

entities.name: riveted metal wall panel
entities.identification: The large cyan-gray to cyan-green rectangular wall panels forming the boundary of the turning passage, with dark rivets arranged near the panel seams.

entities.name: metal floor
entities.identification: The flat, slab-like gray to cyan-green floor beneath the passage, with a low-contrast mottled texture and panel seams.

entities.name: dark-colored metal ceiling
entities.identification: The dark gray to nearly black ceiling surface at the top of the passage, with multiple parallel layered trim strips visible along the tops of the walls.

entities.name: indoor light fixture
entities.identification: The partially exposed cyan-green glowing light fixture near the top of the wall in the upper-left of the opening view.
